item.title: Introducing ggsci for Rust
item.description: Photo by Rémi Müller. Welcome to the latest post of the “Introducing X for Y” series. Today I’m happy to share that ggsci is now available for Rust. You can add the crates to your Rust project with Cargo: cargo add ggsci cargo add ggsci-ratatui cargo add ggsci-ggsql ggsci for R started ten years ago as a small collection of color palettes inspired by scientific journals and science fiction, packaged as ggplot2 color scales.
